title: A lighter Consegna page on mobile
subtitle: GASS 2.30.x — mockup design/mockups/consegna-mobile-compatta.html
context:
Request (2026-10-14), after looking at the 2.30 preview on a phone: the mobile Consegna page is too full. (1) Notebook photos, note and tolti/rimessi should live in a section of their own, as a modal. (2) Maybe the cassa summaries should leave the Consegna page and show only once the consegna is closed. (3) In the participant card, the saldo before today (credito/debito) should move under Importo saldato.

Today (mobile, `public/consegna.html`): header, cassa row (Trovato/Incassato/Pagato/In cassa) + tolti/rimessi lines + quote teatro, status box with Chiudi/Annulla, Quaderno block, Note, tolti/rimessi rows, then the add select and the list "Chi ha ritirato". The participant card (`buildParticipantCardHTML` in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js`) is full-screen at ≤ 768px and shows "prima di oggi" as a pill in its header.

Mockup: `design/mockups/consegna-mobile-compatta.html` (sections G, H, I = decisions F1, F2, F3). Ships together with the 2.30.0 work not yet released.

glossary.definition: A full-screen panel over the page with a back arrow, like the participant card on mobile.

decisions.title: Detail, entrate/uscite, notebook and note in a sheet of their own
decisions.why: On a phone the list of people starts about two screens down: the turnista scrolls past cassa, status, notebook, note and rows at every person. Moving them changes where people look for things they learned last week, so it is worth one decision.
decisions.proposal: On mobile the page shows one taller box **without a title**: the details on several lines (**conto produttore**, **quote teatro**, the **movimenti di cassa with their motivo**), then a button-like footer **"Apri: dettaglio, entrate/uscite, quaderno, note ›"**. The whole box is one tap target and opens a **full-screen sheet** ("Dettaglio, entrate/uscite, quaderno, note") built like the participant card (back arrow, Salva): full cassa (Trovato, Incassato, Pagato, entrate/uscite, In cassa), quote teatro, Quaderno, **Entrate/uscite di cassa** (was "Soldi tolti o rimessi in cassa"), Note della giornata. The status buttons are **Annulla consegna** (left) and **Chiudi consegna** (right); where they sit is F5. Desktop unchanged.
decisions.learn_more: The sheet reuses the existing elements (`#quaderno-box`, `#uscite-edit`, `#noteGiornata`, `#uscite-errore`) moved into a container that gets the same full-screen CSS as `.participant-card-flow` at ≤ 768px, so saving, drafts and the close reminder keep working. "Fotografa prima" in the close dialog opens the sheet first. Leaving the sheet with unsaved changes asks like the card does ("Modifiche non salvate"). The box lists only what you named; In cassa and the notebook count are in the sheet (say so if you want them in the box too).

options.label: Taller summary box, full-screen sheet on tap
pros: The list starts right under the header
Same gesture as the participant card
cons: One tap more to reach note and notebook

options.label: Collapsible block in the page (closed by default)
cons: Still pushes the list down when open
Two kinds of 'open' on one page

tasks.title: Move cassa, notebook, note and rows into a mobile sheet
tasks.do: `consegna.html`: wrap the cassa row, quote teatro, `#quaderno-box` and `#note-giornata-group` in `#giornata-sheet` with a header (back, title "Riepilogo, entrate/uscite cassa, teatro e note") and the Salva; add the summary box `#giornata-row` (lines + footer "Apri: dettaglio, entrate/uscite, quaderno, note ›": Conto produttore = `calculatePagatoProduttore()`, Quote teatro = `quoteOggi`, one line per `usciteVersi()` entry with motivo) before the add select; rename the block label to "Entrate/uscite di cassa" (mobile and desktop, `tips.js` text too); swap the order: Annulla consegna, then Chiudi consegna; place `#consegna-status-section` as decided in F5. `consegna.js`: `openGiornata()` / `closeGiornata()` (unsaved check) and `renderGiornataRow()` called from `updateLasciatoInCassa`/`renderQuoteOggi`. `style.css`: sheet full-screen at ≤ 768px like `.participant-card-flow`. `apriQuaderno` opens the sheet first on mobile.
acceptance: On a 390 px phone the list starts within the first screen
The box has no title, a button-like footer with ›, and opens the sheet on any tap
Note, rows and photos save as before; drafts still restore
"Fotografa prima" opens the sheet and the camera
Annulla on the left, Chiudi on the right

revision.note: Box without title, footer "Apri: dettaglio, entrate/uscite, quaderno, note", block renamed "Entrate/uscite di cassa", Annulla/Chiudi swapped. The position of the buttons is now F5, with the scroll mockup J. Three rounds on this one: if anything is still off, we can settle it in the chat.

decisions.title: Where Annulla / Chiudi consegna sit on mobile
decisions.why: Closing happens once per consegna, after the cash is counted; a button that is hard to find gets the consegna left open, one that is always under the thumb gets tapped by mistake. On a phone only the bottom navigation stays on screen while scrolling.
decisions.proposal: **At the bottom of the page, after the list** (J1): reached by scrolling to the end, where the turnista is anyway when everyone has been entered. Annulla on the left, Chiudi on the right; both ask for confirmation.

visual.alt: Mockup J: the page at the start, middle and end of scrolling for three placements: J1 at the bottom, J2 fixed bar above the navigation, J3 at the top
visual.caption: Mockup section J: the same page with 18 people at three scroll positions

decisions.learn_more: Today on mobile only the bottom navigation (Consegna, Saldi, Storico, Turni) is fixed; the season header with the date scrolls away. With J2 the bar is fixed too and takes about 56 px from the list on every screen.

options.label: J1 · At the bottom, after the list
pros: Nothing fixed added; the list gets the whole screen
Found at the natural end of the work
cons: You must scroll to the end to close

options.label: J2 · Fixed bar above the navigation
cons: Takes screen from the list at every scroll
Close to the navigation: more accidental taps (confirmation still asked)

options.label: J3 · At the top, under the header
cons: Pushes the summary box and the list down
Scroll back to the top to close

decisions.title: Where the cassa summary is while the consegna is open
decisions.why: Whoever counts the cash compares it with In cassa before closing. Hiding it while open removes a check the turnisti use; showing it on the page is what makes it full.
decisions.proposal: As in F1: while the consegna is open the page shows the taller summary box (conto produttore, quote teatro, movimenti di cassa with motivo); Trovato, Incassato and In cassa are inside the sheet. When the consegna is closed, the page shows the full cassa at the top, read-only, as today.

decisions.title: "Prima di oggi" under Importo saldato in the card
decisions.why: The saldo before today is what turns conto and versato into credito/debito; shown as a pill in the header it is read apart from the numbers it explains.
decisions.proposal: Remove the pill from the card header; show a row **"Prima di oggi: debito −53,44 €"** (or credito, or "pari") right under Importo saldato, before "Debito saldato per intero" / Lascia credito.
